title: 科研项目主页结构模板

description.zh: 原创可编辑 SVG 主页叙事板，规划主张、结果、演示、方法与局限的展示顺序；不是可运行 HTML。
description.en: Editable SVG visual storyboard for a research homepage hero, evidence, demos and limitations; not a functioning HTML website.

zh: 需要规划论文项目主页的首屏与证据分区
想先确认信息结构，再实施 HTML 网页
en: Planning the first screen and evidence sections of a research project site
Drafting information architecture before implementing HTML

zh: 先用可证伪的单句主张建立阅读重点
主张之后接最有说服力的真实证据和演示
保持来源、局限与复现入口可见
en: Lead with a falsifiable one-sentence claim
Follow with authentic evidence and demonstrations
Make attribution, limitations and reproducibility routes visible

zh: 示例文字和视觉全部为占位，不能原样当成实验结果
本模板是可编辑静态 SVG，不包含网页交互功能
en: Every claim and visual is placeholder content, not experimental results
This editable SVG is a static design storyboard, not interactive website code
